verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM's pricing page directly claims a record-enrichment capability that works on single records or in bulk. The wording "whenever you choose" points to user-triggered enrichment, not automatic enrichment, and nothing says which data fields get filled. The Apollo integration listing is a third-party connector, not first-party enrichment, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic enrichment on record creation, documentation of the firmographic and contact data fields enriched, coverage of both contact and company records, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have contact and company records auto-enriched with firmographic and contact data

citations.quote: Enrich single records or hundreds at once, whenever you choose
